principles.title: Production first
principles.text: Architecture and delivery choices are made for real users, real operations and the next stage of the product.

principles.title: Clear scope
principles.text: Every engagement starts with a defined outcome, constraints and a delivery path before implementation expands.

principles.title: Evidence over hype
principles.text: We publish verified outcomes and keep unverified client names, logos and performance claims out of the site.

faqs.a: AI products, SaaS systems, business automation, internal platforms and client-facing software experiences.
A short project signal leads into qualification and discovery. Scope, timeline and commercial terms are confirmed before delivery.

faqs.q: Do you work with existing products?
faqs.a: Yes. NEREON can extend, rebuild or harden an existing product when the business case and technical context support it.
Pricing follows discovery. Published ranges are positioning guidance rather than a guaranteed quote.
